message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for the described facts.

Facts: Defendant Ye rented his home premises to Hong, who used it to operate a gambling machine shop (illegal gambling). Ye knew Hong was a convicted person (already sentenced) and still rented the place for gambling. The gambling operation was discovered, equipment seized. Ye voluntarily surrendered (self-report). The prosecution suggests a sentence of less than one year and fine.

We need to identify the crime(s). Under Chinese criminal law, operating gambling machines is illegal. The crime of "开设赌场" (opening a casino) or "非法经营赌博" (illegal gambling operation). Also, "容留他人吸毒" is not relevant. The relevant is "开设赌场罪" (organizing/operating a gambling venue). The person who provides the venue for gambling may be charged with "开设赌场罪" as well, as a participant. The law: Article 303 of Criminal Law: "开设赌场的，处三年以下有期徒刑、拘役或者管制，并处罚金；情节严重的，处三年以上七年以下有期徒刑，并处罚金。" Also "为他人提供场所、设施、资金等帮助" can be considered as "开设赌场罪" as an accomplice. So the charge is "开设赌场罪". The Chinese label used in examples: they use "非法组织卖血" etc. For gambling they used "赌博;开设赌场". In earlier example: "黄3某...组织‘时时彩’赌博活动" answer: "赌博;开设赌场". That case had both gambling and opening casino. In this case, the defendant only provided venue, not necessarily operating machines. Could be "开设赌场" only. Might also be "容留他人吸毒" no. So answer: [罪名]开设赌场<eoa>.

Check if any other charge like "帮助他人开设赌场" but official label is "开设赌场". Use that.
